title: kit.upload-serve.v1
description: The response headers of a released upload (@saasreport/uploads serveHeaders and downloadResponse; a consumer that serves uploads itself sets exactly these). An upload is only ever served with the content type of its sniffed kind (application/octet-stream for a kind that could run in a browser) and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and as an attachment unless the policy declares the kind inline-safe (policy.serve.inline_types, raster images only), in which case it carries the restrictive image CSP. Header names are lower case, as a Headers object lists them.

content-type.description: The sniffed type when it is on the inert allowlist (serve.js INERT_TYPES), otherwise application/octet-stream: an allowlist, so a new runnable type can never be served by omission. A test keeps this enum equal to INERT_TYPES plus application/octet-stream.

oneOf.title: inline (only a raster image the policy declares inline-safe)
